book.name: 1 Korint
book.title: 1 Korint Nalob̃ulat napisulan na-vǝha-sual-an aPol totosi van hǝn alat a Korint

content: Nalǝlǝgauan: alat a Israel ta m̃o lumabe?
Nokǝmaienan bathudud nadǝlomian, husur nomǝtahun mǝtb̃etǝtan hǝn nategai. Atǝmadat ta sutuai p̃isi lotogam dan naut a Ijip, lutoh pipit nǝmavukasw, galit p̃isi luyar tukot len tas.
Len nǝmavukasw mai nǝtas, ehum galit p̃isi lotobaptais hǝn lǝb̃evi ahai susur siMoses.
Ale galit p̃isi luhan nǝhanian tosua ŋai togǝm len aGot.
Ale galit p̃isi lomun nǝwai tosua ŋai togǝm len aGot, husur lomun nǝwai hǝn nǝvat siGot totah mai galito, ale nǝvat enan evi aKristo.
Avil aGot sahǝhaṽur hǝn galit lotosob̃ur, ale lumat, nab̃irimat halit gail losuh taṽtaṽor len naut masmas.
Natgalenan lovisi hum nalǝlǝgauan hǝn asike datb̃elǝŋon masuṽ hǝn natit tosa gail sum̃an galito.
Samtilotu hǝn nǝlablab gail sum̃an galit galevis lotogole, hum natosian siGot toke, “Nǝvanuan gail lobǝtah hǝn lǝb̃ihan, lǝb̃emun. Ale lule mǝhat hǝn lǝb̃isav, ram̃ram̃e taṽtaṽor.”
Sadatigol naitian tosa sum̃an galit galevis, togol nǝvanuan tovi 23,000 len galito lumat len nǝmariboŋ tosua ŋai.
Sadatitaltal kitev nǝdaŋan siNasub̃ aGot ke timabe. Galit galevis lugole, gol nǝm̃at gail lukat bubun galito.
Sadatikoblen sum̃an galit galevis lotokoblen, gol aŋel hǝn nǝmatan igol lumat.
Natgalenan lovisi hǝn galito hǝn datb̃elǝboi sǝhoti, ale ipat len na-tos-gati-an hum na-sor-p̃usan-an m̃os gidat dattotoh len nǝboŋ hǝn nanoŋan hǝn navile a pan.
Avan ideh b̃inau ke toil gǝgat, telǝlǝgau hǝn asike b̃iteh!

Natideh totaltal ke mitigol nǝsaan, ep̃itoṽ hǝn nǝsa togǝm hǝn nǝvanuan gail p̃isi. Be aGot igol tabtab hǝn nǝsa tokele ke tigole. Natideh totaltal ke mitigol nǝsaan, aGot asike idam̃ hǝn ideh sǝhor nǝsa mǝttolǝboi mǝtb̃idaŋ b̃uri. Nǝboŋ natideh b̃italtal ke mǝtb̃igol nǝsaan, dereh aGot tigol nap̃isal dan natenan hǝn mǝtb̃idaŋ b̃uri.
Imagenan gamit notolǝmas bun gamit p̃isi, mitigam dan nalotuan van hǝn nǝlablab gail.
Nusor mai gamit hum mǝttokad nǝnauan; nǝb̃ekitin o asike nǝb̃ekitin, mitinau hǝn mǝtb̃inau sǝhoti.
Len nǝhanian len natev siNasub̃, nǝboŋ dattosipa vi tǝban aGot hǝn nab̃iliwai, datomun katǝp̃ol hǝn nǝda heKristo. Ale nǝboŋ dattob̃ur nabǝta, datuhan katǝp̃ol hǝn niben aKristo. Mǝtsalǝboii a?
Naut kǝmas dattosob̃ur, gidat p̃isi datovi niben tosua ŋai, husur datuhan katǝp̃ol hǝn nabǝta tosua ŋai.
Mitinau naṽide silat a Israel. Galit ṽisusua lotohan nahudhuviolan lototutumav hǝni van hǝn aGot, len nǝmel tutumavan, luhan katǝp̃ol, ale lub̃on len nalotuan van hǝn aGot.
Namilen ke nǝlablab evi natideh a? Ao. Namilen ke nǝhanian lototutumav hǝni van hǝni evi natideh a?
Ao. Arsavi natideh. Nukele ke, natideh nǝvanuan lǝsǝkad nadǝlomian lototutumav hǝni, lotutumav hǝni van hǝn natǝmat gail, savi aGot. Nomǝtahun mǝtb̃ikatǝp̃ol mai natǝmat gail.
Mǝtsalǝboi mǝtb̃emun len nab̃iliwai hiNasub̃ ale mun len nab̃iliwai hetǝmat gail am. Mǝtsalǝboi mǝtb̃ihan len natev siNasub̃ ale han len natev setǝmat gail am.
Datb̃igol b̃imagenan, dereh datigol Nasub̃ aGot titab̃ulol bulos gidato. Datunau ke datudaŋ sǝhori a? Aoa!

Gamit mǝtb̃ike, “Len nǝmakuvan sinamit dan nalo namtolǝboi namtb̃igol natideh,” ginau nuke, naṽide galevis lǝsavoi hǝn nǝvanuan tile gail. Gamit mǝtb̃ike, “Len nǝmakuvan sinamit dan nalo namtolǝboi namtb̃igol natideh,” ginau nuke, naṽide galevis lǝsagol nǝvanuan togon sǝdaŋ am len nadǝlomian san.
Samtelǝŋon nǝsa tovoi hǝn gamit sǝb̃omit ŋai, be mǝtelǝŋon nǝsa tovoi hǝn nǝvanuan tile gail.
Mǝtolǝboi mǝtb̃ihan natideh lotop̃ur hǝni len nǝmaket hǝn namǝŋod. Lǝb̃etutumav hǝni van hǝn nǝlablab gail o asike lǝb̃igole, samteus nausian ideh husuri. Samtinau masuṽ hǝni.
Naṽide enan inor husur nasoruan siGot ikele ke, “Navile a pan mai natit p̃isi topul lan lovi siNasub̃ aGot.”

Nǝvanuan sǝkad nadǝlomian b̃eus gaiug hǝn gǝb̃ihan maii, ale gǝb̃elǝŋon gǝb̃ivan, gihan nǝhanian ideh gai b̃ilavi mai gaiug. Lǝb̃etutumav hǝni van hǝn nǝlablab o asike lǝb̃igole, sageus nausian ideh husuri. Saginau masuṽ hǝni.

Be avan ideh b̃ikel mai gaiug ke, “Namǝŋod egai, lotutumav hǝni van hǝn nǝlablab gail,” sagihani be nǝnauan sam̃ tinau nǝlon avan enan tokel vǝhot natenan mai gaiug. Gǝb̃ihani, hum ma gǝb̃etunus nǝlon.
Hum ma savi natideh len gaiug, be evi natit tosa len nǝnauan sinǝvanuan togon. Husur, imabe nǝnauan len nǝlon nǝvanuan togon isab̃i ke nǝsa notogole len nǝmakuvan sagw dan nalo isa?
Ginau nǝb̃esipa vi tǝban aGot hǝn nǝhanian ale nǝb̃ihani, imabe avan ideh isor mǝdas ginau bathut nǝsa notosipa hǝni tia?
Imaienan, mǝtb̃ihan o mǝtb̃emun o natideh mǝtb̃igole, gol natit p̃isi hǝn nǝvanuan gail lǝb̃isal suh nǝyalyalan siGot lan.
Samtigol natideh hǝn mǝtb̃ip̃on gol na-kel-uri-an tovoi hǝn naJu gail o alat lǝsavi Ju asike lǝb̃ikad nadǝlomian. Samtigol natideh hǝn mǝtb̃emǝdas nadǝlomian silat siYesu.

Mǝtehusur naṽide sagw. Len natit p̃isi notogole, nohisi hǝn nǝb̃igol nǝvanuan p̃isi lǝb̃ehǝhaṽur lan. Nǝsǝdas p̃isal hǝn nǝb̃ikad na-vi-tarhǝte-an m̃os ginau sǝb̃ogw ŋai, nudas p̃isal hǝn nǝvanuan b̃isob̃ur lǝb̃ikad na-vi-tarhǝte-an, hǝn aGot b̃ilav kuv galit dan nǝsaan salito.

footnotes.text: 10.1 Exo 13.21-22, 14.22-29. Nǝboŋ toke lotoyar tukot len tas, luyar tukot len naut butitas nǝtas torus dani gol ke tokad nap̃isal tomasmas rivuh be nǝtas ipat tarhǝte tarhǝte.
10.29 Len naves 28 nǝboŋ tosor husur avan ideh mai avan enan, ale len naves 29 nǝboŋ tosor husur nǝvanuan togon, len naut galenan, isor husur nǝvanuan sǝkad nadǝlomian.
